name: Nerima-Takanodai
tagline: Shinjuku in 32 minutes and Shibuya in 37 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥70,000 to ¥80,000.
summary: The station is in Nerima City, where Seibu run 1 line between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 43 minutes to Otemachi, 32 minutes to Shinjuku, 37 minutes to Shibuya and 53 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥70,000 to ¥80,000. The station stands 39.2 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 7.4 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits lower than the ground around it, at 39.2 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from 38.1 m to 45.5 m, a difference of 7.4 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of less than 0.5 m. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 2 also fall inside the area, and the deepest projection is less than 0.5 m. The station itself is inside the projected area, but few of the points around it are. Compared with other stations in the 23 wards, the flood projection here is on the small side.

groceries.name: ピーコックストア 高野台店

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 4 clinics and 4 pharmacies. The nearest hospital is 順天堂大学医学部附属 練馬病院, about 4 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 慈誠会練馬高野台病院, about 9 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Seibu Ikebukuro Line.
congestion: Seibu Ikebukuro Line runs at 130% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 椎名町→池袋; trains from here toward 池袋 pass through it. At 100%, the ministry's scale describes every passenger either seated or able to hold a strap or pillar. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥70,000 to ¥80,000 and 1K ¥80,000 to ¥90,000. 1LDK ¥130,000 to ¥140,000 and 2LDK ¥160,000 to ¥170,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

rentReason: A one-room flat here goes for ¥70,000 to ¥80,000. Set against how long it takes to reach the central business districts, that is about average for the 23 wards. a small projected flood depth and schools and parks within walking distance pushes the figure up. On the other side, only one line, the {line}, serving the station holds it down. For 1LDK, 2LDK, though, the sources differ by ¥30,000 or more. They count different sets of properties, so read those figures as a range rather than a point.

neighbours.lead: For the number of places to eat out, Shakujii-Koen; for quiet, Nerima-Takanodai.
neighbours.note: Close enough to walk to from Nerima-Takanodai. It is served by the same lines as Nerima-Takanodai. Journey times to the main business districts are much the same. On the number of places to eat out, Shakujii-Koen comes out ahead. Within about 13 minutes' walk, Shakujii-Koen has 26 restaurants and Nerima-Takanodai has 5.

neighbours.lead: For how easy the shopping is, Fujimidai; for how little of the area is in the flood projection, Nerima-Takanodai.
neighbours.note: About 1.5 km from Nerima-Takanodai in a straight line. It is served by the same lines as Nerima-Takanodai. Journey times to the main business districts are much the same. On what it offers families, Nerima-Takanodai comes out ahead.

goodFor: People who get around by bicycle or with a pushchair
People living alone who want to hold the rent down
notFor: People who want another route when service is suspended
People who want plenty of places to eat out
noiseSources: 笹目通り (2 lanes each way) runs just outside the station. In a flat facing it, the cars are audible morning and evening

leads.terrain: The ground around the station is almost level, so you can choose where to live without thinking about slopes.
leads.groceries: There are 6 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 1 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself sits inside the area projected to flood in the heaviest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: Only the Seibu Ikebukuro Line serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
leads.rentRange: The balance between commuting time and rent is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is on the low side for the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Seibu Ikebukuro Line trains toward 池袋 pass through the line's busiest stretch, but at 130% passengers are not shoulder to shoulder.
leads.noiseSources: Whether a flat faces the road changes what you hear indoors.
